name: The Masters of Armageddon

tenures.role: stable — "MoA Corp," a self-described multi-division corporation
tenures.source: the fed's own served Current Roster page (promotions/moa/archive/current-roster.html)
tenures.note: The Current Roster page carries no internal date; the stable's own founding is traced by this wing's own promotions.json row to the WCIWA, September 1997, well before any document held in the wing's own record.

notes: Members[] captures the Current Roster page's own snapshot: twelve wrestlers split across two named "divisions" of OTHER federations the Masters have infiltrated — the PWA division (Darren Ridel, Nightstryker, Gabrielle, Silverback, The Rage, Marcus Collins, Phoenix, The Brutal) and the UW division (Jamie Williams, Frost, Fley, Jason Creed) — plus Styx himself as the stable's own founder and leader, who carries no wrestler bio card of his own on the roster page. "The following are the men and women who continually fight to keep the MoA the dominating force that it has always been... MoA dominance is ensured in their respective federations," per the page's own framing — the Masters are staged as a faction embedded within other promotions' own rosters rather than a promotion running its own regular cards. This reading is independently corroborated by the held pwa-pioneer wing's own "Wednesday Night Chaos" broadcast, which stages "MoA" by name as a faction within the PWA itself ("the ADC has been quick to have orders for MoA the PWA Chapter created"). Flesh and Vigilance are explicitly billed as FORMER M.o.A members in "One Last Dance" and are deliberately excluded from members[] — see their own character rows (flesh-moa, vigilance-moa) rather than double-counting a lapsed membership here.
caption: A wrestling stable and self-described corporation whose own members wrestle embedded within two other federations' rosters — the PWA and the UW — to spread its own dominance.

identity.note: "Armageddon"/"Master(s)" are common wrestling-nickname fragments independently billed across several unrelated feds -- no shared detail ties any of them to this MoA stable. Filed distinct pending evidence, per the collision doctrine.
